cards.text: Friend, the writer of the Gospel of John opens his book for his readers like a song, and he starts all the way back. "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." He was with God in the beginning.

cards.question: The Word was with God, and the Word was God. What was made through the Word?

cards.text: Every last thing, friend, from every star in the sky to every dust bunny in the back of my old junk drawer. And then: "In Him was life, and that life was the light of men."
And here's the picture, friend: the Light shines in the darkness.

cards.question: The darkness has not overcome the Light.

cards.text: Now a man shows up who was sent from God. His name was John, a man who baptized people (John 1:28), and he came as a witness to testify about the Light.

cards.question: John came as a witness to testify about the Light. Why?

answers.text: So everyone might believe through him
So people would come to follow him
So the temple leaders would listen

cards.text: Now the true Light, the one who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world. EVERYONE, friend, even a dusty old stamper from the back of a drawer.
He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him… wait for it, friend.

cards.question: Though the world was made through the true Light, what does the world do when He is in it?

answers.text: It tries to chase Him away
It runs and hides from Him

cards.text: And it goes further: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him. His OWN, friend.

cards.question: But to all who did receive the true Light, those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become ___ of God.
The children of God are born of the will of man.

cards.text: They're born of God, friend. And then the big one: "The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us."

cards.question: The Word became flesh. The writer says, "We have seen His glory…" Whose glory is it?

answers.text: The one and only Son from the Father
The great prophet sent from the Father
The mighty angel sent from the Father

cards.text: And He's full of grace and truth. Then John, the witness sent from God, cries out about Him.

cards.question: John says the one who comes after him has surpassed him because He was before him.

cards.text: Then the writer says, "From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace." Grace upon GRACE, friend.

cards.question: The law was given through Moses, Israel's leader. Grace and truth came through ___.
No one has ever seen God. What has the one and only Son done?

answers.text: He has built God a temple

cards.text: And that Son is Himself God, right there at the Father's side.
